en: Colorized vintage view over a riverside industrial town. In the foreground, steam-powered riverboats are moored at a quay along a calm river with railway tracks and freight wagons beside the bank. Behind them rise factories with tall chimneys, warehouses, and a mix of residential and civic buildings on a low hill. The image is captioned in red text at the top with a German title describing the steamship landing place in Riesa on the Elbe River.
